people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom:
translations.bsb: who had not consented to their decision or action. He was from the Judean town of Arimathea and was waiting for the kingdom of God.
translations.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
